rule: Business anchors are human-memory display and search labels composed from truth-object projections, runtime events, WorkItem context, and session-safe payload context. They must not become authoritative business facts or write inputs.

forbiddenUses: using name or phone as fact owner
submitting anchor text as command truth
letting frontend-generated anchors replace backend object ids
showing raw runtime ids to ordinary users when a display anchor exists

anchorPattern.visiblePattern: room label · bed label · person display name · masked phone · current action
anchorPattern.example: D02 / 22 · 01 upper bunk · Zhang San · 138****1234 · deposit waiting confirmation
anchorPattern.searchPattern: room label, bed label, person display name, masked and raw phone tokens, current action
anchorPattern.privacy: Visible phone values must be masked. Raw phone values may be used only as local search tokens or backend search keys under Search Kernel permission.

scenarioAnchors.name: lead to reservation to stay to bed assignment
scenarioAnchors.currentActionSource: active WorkItem card or admission-safe next action

surfaceRequirements: Workbench task cards must show one business anchor line when any anchor token is available.
Search result cards must include the same anchor line and rank against anchor tokens.
Learning Center scenario cards must explain scenarios through the same anchor pattern.
Operation step rails must show the case anchor near the current workspace title.
Anchor rendering must share the kernel and must not be copied page by page.
evidenceRequirements: real browser screenshot for Learning Center anchor
real browser screenshot for Search anchor
